reviews.title: Works as intended.

reviews.title: One stick failed after 4 months of light use
reviews.comment: Reliability is less then stellar. I had continuous system glitches until I replaced it. I attempted to RMA today and support's playing 20 questions, asking me to stick it in a diff system, or back into my own rig and run tests.
reviews.author: David Alrajabi
